```{r}

packages <- 
  c(
    "fixest",
    "broom",
    "tidyverse",
    "modelsummary",
    "vtable",
    "skimr"
  )

pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE)

```


```{r census desc stats}


cen <- read_csv(file.path(user_path(), "1_1_baseline_census.csv"))


cen %>%
  select(
    -c(
      block,
      panchayat_village,
      ends_with("id")
    )
  ) %>%
  sumtable(
    group = "assignment",
    title  = "Baseline demographics and behavior"
  )






```





```{r}


# Data -------------------------------------------------------------------------

outcomes <-
  c(
    # "Presence of Total Coliform at Taps"= "cf_pa_tap",
    # "Presence of E. coli at Taps"= "ec_pa_tap",
    # "Presence of Total Coliform in Stored Water"= "cf_pa_stored",
    # "Presence of E. coli in Stored Water"= "ec_pa_stored",
    "Taps as Primary Source" = "prim_source_jjm",
    "Use a Secondary Source" = "sec_source",
    "Drink Tap Water" = "jjm_drinking",
    "Treat Water" = "water_treat_binary",
    "Treat Water > 5 min" = "time_spent_treat_5",
    "Reported Water Taste/Smell Issue" = "tap_issues_taste"
    
  )


analysis <-
  read_rds(
    file.path(
      user_path(),
      "analysis_data.rds"
    )
  )

# fu_village <-
#   analysis %>%
#   group_by(village, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment) %>%
#   summarise(
#     across(
#       c(outcomes) %>% unname,
#       ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)
#     ),
#     across(
#       ends_with("_bl"),
#       ~ unique(.)
#     ),
#     N = n()
#   )

analysis <- analysis%>%
  mutate(
    tap_issues_taste_bl = 1
  )%>%
  rename(time_spent_treat_5_bl = treat_time_5min_bl)
  

el_village <-
  analysis %>%
  group_by(village, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(outcomes) %>% unname,
      ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    across(
      ends_with("_bl"),
      ~ unique(.)
    ),
    N = n()
  )%>%
  mutate(
    tap_issues_taste_bl = 1
  )

#SKimming data
el_village%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  skim()

# Running regression models -----------------------------------------------------



# Village level ----------------------------------------------------------------

vil <-
   outcomes %>%
  # map(
  #   ~ list(
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) | block + panchayat_village"),
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) | stratum"),
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N))"),
  #     paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl"))
  #   ) %>%
  #     map(~ as.formula(paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl")))) %>%
       map(
        ~ feglm(
          paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl"))%>%as.formula(),
          data = el_village,
          family = poisson,
          se = 'iid'
        )
      )
  #)



vil %>%
   modelsummary(
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    coef_rename = c("assignmentTreatment" = "Treatment"),
    coef_omit = "^(?!.*Treatment)",
    gof_omit = "IC|R2|RMSE",
    estimate  = "{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
    statistic = NULL,
    shape = model ~ term + statistic,
    add_columns = data.frame("N"= map(., ~.x$nobs) %>% unlist %>% round)
  )




```


```{r IDEXX analysis}



analysis_idexx <-
  read_rds(
    file.path(
      user_path(),
      "analysis_idexx.rds"
    )
  )


outcomes <-
  c(
    "Presence of Total Coliform at Taps"= "cf_pa_tap",
    "Presence of E. coli at Taps"= "ec_pa_tap",
    "Presence of Total Coliform in Stored Water"= "cf_pa_stored",
    "Presence of E. coli in Stored Water"= "ec_pa_stored"
    
  )


#Prepping village level data
idexx_village <-
  analysis_idexx %>%
  group_by(village, block, panchayat_village, stratum, assignment) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(outcomes) %>% unname,
      ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    across(
      ends_with("_bl"),
      ~ unique(.)
    ),
    N = n()
  )

#SKimming data
idexx_village%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  skim()

# Running regression models -----------------------------------------------------




# Village level ----------------------------------------------------------------

vil <-
   outcomes %>%
  # map(
  #   ~ list(
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) | block + panchayat_village"),
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) | stratum"),
  #      # paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N))"),
  #     paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl"))
  #   ) %>%
  #     map(~ as.formula(paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl")))) %>%
       map(
        ~ feglm(
          paste(., "~ assignment + offset(log(N)) +", paste0(., "_bl"))%>%as.formula(),
          data = idexx_village,
          family = poisson,
          se = 'iid'
        )
      )
  #)


vil %>%
   modelsummary(
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    coef_rename = c("assignmentTreatment" = "Treatment"),
    coef_omit = "^(?!.*Treatment)",
    gof_omit = "IC|R2|RMSE",
    estimate  = "{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
    statistic = NULL,
    shape = model ~ term + statistic,
    add_columns = data.frame("N"= map(., ~.x$nobs) %>% unlist %>% round)
  )



```
